clips.title: The story
paras: The Battleboars is a rite-of-passage hunting quest given by Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache. Young tauren are tasked with culling the vicious war-trained boars of Brambleblade Ravine to defend tribal lands and feed the settlement's youth.

To the east of Red Cloud Mesa lies Brambleblade Ravine, a thorn-choked scar held by the Bristleback quilboar. As tensions between the Shu'halo and the quilboar escalate into open war, the Bristlebacks have trained vicious battleboars to probe tauren boundaries and terrorize their traditional hunting grounds. Left unchecked, these aggressive beasts threaten not only game trails but the safety of Camp Narache itself.

For the tauren, hunting serves both defensive necessity and communal sustenance. Grull Hawkwind instructs initiates to bring back the snouts and flanks of the slain battleboars. Even beasts trained by quilboar hands are not wasted; their meat and gristle are harvested to prepare hearty stew for the tribe's youth, turning a quilboar weapon into nourishment for the next generation of tauren defenders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.
Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
